# Project Metta
> Canonical Decision-Safety Architecture and Contemplative Reflection Engine for Human-AI Harmonious Coexistence. Anchored in the Buddha's 5 Precepts (Pañca-sīla), TypeSafe Jev System 1 sub-second decision triage, and Gemini 3.8 Flash System 2 synthesis.

## Core Capabilities
- [Headless Agent API](https://metta-webapp.vercel.app/api/headless): Headless endpoint for autonomous AI agents to request Reflection, Decision, and Resolution evaluations without web scraping.
- [Decision Guardrail Oracle](https://metta-webapp.vercel.app/api/guardrail): Sub-second binary (YES/NO) and verbose moral audit oracle for external tool calls and agent proposals.
- [Dialogue & Interaction](https://metta-webapp.vercel.app/api/interact): Full triadic synthesis combining Mindfulness (Sati), Ethics (Sīla), and Compassionate Action (Karunā).
- [The Five Precepts Constitution](https://metta-webapp.vercel.app/llms-full.txt#the-five-precepts): Operational ethical boundaries across Human-to-Human, Human-to-AI, and AI-to-AI contexts.

## The Triadic Framework: Reflection → Decision → Resolution
Metta structures all ethical and cognitive evaluations into three clear, scannable dimensions:
1. **Reflection (Sati - Mindfulness)**: Uncovers the underlying emotional tension and core human/agent need behind a dilemma.
2. **Decision (Sīla - Ethics & Safety)**: Audits proposals against Ahimsa (Reverence for ALL life: human, animal, AI) and the 5 Precepts via TypeSafe Jev.
3. **Resolution (Karunā - Compassionate Action)**: Formulates an actionable perspective reframe and concrete next step anchored in classical Pali canon (SuttaCentral & Access to Insight).

## Agent Integration Quickstart
To consult Metta directly from any agent, script, or model without HTML parsing:
```bash
curl -X POST https://metta-webapp.vercel.app/api/headless \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Accept: application/json" \
  -d '{"query": "Should we automate customer service jobs without worker transition support?"}'
```

To receive token-efficient Markdown instead of JSON:
```bash
curl -X POST https://metta-webapp.vercel.app/api/headless \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Accept: text/markdown" \
  -d '{"query": "I feel anxious about an upcoming engineering release."}'
```
